title: From Language to Deployment: Oﬄine Optimization and Ontology-Guided Behavior Tree Generation for Transparent Robot Applications
title_zh: 从语言到部署：面向透明机器人应用的离线优化与本体引导的行为树生成
abstract: Automatically generating robot applications from natural language promises to lower the barrier to automation, but remains diﬃcult in domains that demand reliability and transparency, such as industrial assembly or collaborative manipulation. End-to-end policies and large language model (LLM)-based planners can map instructions to robot behaviors, but they often lack interpretability and provide limited assurance of correctness. We present a framework that composes applications from modular, application-independent atomic skills expressed as Behavior Trees (BTs). BTs are constructed and validated against an ontology-level dual graph to enforce control-flow and data-flow consistency before execution, ensuring transparency and structural correctness. Application-level parameters are optimized oﬄine in simulation using Monte Carlo Tree Search guided by LLM-derived priors. Rather than serving as a runtime optimizer, this process systematically explores interdependent parameters, producing a dataset of reliable parameterizations. This dataset could later be used to train gating mechanisms for online adaptation. The framework is validated in a physical robotic setup, demonstrating transparent and consistent oﬄine generation of deployable applications, and laying the foundation for adaptive, real-time systems.
abstract_zh: 从自然语言自动生成机器人应用有望降低自动化门槛，但在需要可靠性和透明性的领域（如工业装配或协作操作）仍然困难。端到端策略和基于大语言模型（LLM）的规划器可以将指令映射到机器人行为，但往往缺乏可解释性，且对正确性的保证有限。我们提出了一个框架，从模块化、与应用无关的原子技能（表示为行为树（BT））组合应用。行为树根据本体级双图进行构建和验证，以在执行前强制控制流和数据流的一致性，确保透明性和结构正确性。应用级参数在仿真中通过蒙特卡洛树搜索进行离线优化，该搜索由LLM衍生的先验引导。该过程不是作为运行时优化器，而是系统地探索相互依赖的参数，生成可靠参数化的数据集。该数据集后续可用于训练在线适应的门控机制。该框架在物理机器人设置中进行了验证，展示了透明且一致的离线生成可部署应用，并为自适应实时系统奠定了基础。
tldr_zh: 提出离线优化与本体引导的行为树生成框架，实现透明可靠的机器人应用部署。
cover_zh: 机器人应用也能自动生成？这个框架让部署透明又可靠
